title: The Foxcraft Datapack
description: The Official Foxcraft Datapack, originally made for the Foxcraft SMP by Alisa Puffinetta, now available for standalone download :]
body:
# The Foxcraft Datapack
no, as the title might suggest, this datapack isn't about foxes :]

![Puff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/521a872b4c5462c0febcb5a852f559f9724bdf61.png)

## what's it about then, if it's not foxes ?
well, it incorporates a magic system, a crafting system that takes place in the world, structures, and many more things that you'll discover as you play along with the datapack.

it also has elements that can help with automation and factory making as well :]

## Datapack commands to help you get started :
/trigger FoxcraftCommandTrigger set 1
        this command gives the player a guide book to help you get started on what the datapack offers.
        
/trigger FoxcraftCommandTrigger set 2
        this command gives the player a recipe book to help you get accustomed with the custom on-ground crafting system within it.
